text: The mind is restless, turbulent, obstinate, and very difficult to subdue, but it can be brought under control by steady practice and by detachment.
Do your duty, but do not be attached to the fruits of your actions.
He who sees Me in all beings and all beings in Me, does not lose Me, nor am I lost to him.
Set your heart upon your work, but never on its reward.
Perform your obligatory duty, because action is indeed better than inaction.
Change is the law of the universe. What you think of as death is really life.
